Definition: from G2095 and G2983; taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect (religiously, pious):--devout.
BiblicalUsage: eulabḗs is the word for devout. In Luke 2:25, the text says "and the same man [was] just and devout." In Acts 2:5, the text says "devout men."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe eulabḗs shows us that worship is not a performance but a response — we answer what God has done with what we are. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Pentecost; The Birth of Jesus; The Conversion of Paul
